verdict.rationale: Whisper is offered as an API and library, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API version pinning, version identifiers, or a documented deprecation or sunset policy. Model sizes, the 'pip install -U' update command, and the CLI examples do not show a versioned-API contract.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
